FIXED + verified. Root cause: the event-driven reconnect (_onStateChanged on 'closed' -> _scheduleAutoReconnect) was flaky after a host process restart — a dropped socket that never surfaced as a clean 'closed' transition / a rebuild path that could be missed left the app idle on a dead link (clean experiment: 70s, 0 controller-joins on the host = app never re-dialed). Fix: added a reconnect WATCHDOG (Timer.periodic 8s) in cowork_thread_view.dart that forces _scheduleAutoReconnect whenever the controller is down (closed/error/null) with a stored pairing and nothing in flight, resetting the backoff for prompt recovery. Plus the earlier WS pingInterval (drop detection). Verified LIVE: two consecutive host restarts, app auto-reconnected in ~10s each ('controller connected -> reconnect-response -> reconnected with app device'), no manual action. flutter analyze clean; cowork_thread_view + messenger_shell tests 39 pass (watchdog cancelled in dispose, FakeAsync-safe).
